title: Virtual Compute: activation
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The contract status is applied. The contract approval status is approved. Activate an approved application after provisioning evidence confirms the configured resources; record activation time from the frozen clock. Refuse rejected or pending applications. Setup is invoiced under the lifecycle fee basis when setup fee is positive; a waived setup fee creates no charge. Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.

## Evidence — contract state

For activate, The contract status is applied. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, status. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

## Evidence — provisioning approval

For activate, The contract approval status is approved. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, approval status. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

## Contract transition

The agent performs the applied to active contract transition using the authoritative evidence required for that action.
